title.zh: 宣布每年 3 月 23 日为阿克兰省特别公共假日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring March 23 of Every Year as a Special Public Holiday in the Province of Aklan to Commemorate the Death Anniversary of the XIx Martyrs of Aklan
title.orig: An Act Declaring March 23 of Every Year as a Special Public Holiday in the Province of Aklan to Commemorate the Death Anniversary of the XIx Martyrs of Aklan
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 23 tháng 3 hằng năm là ngày lễ đặc biệt tại Tỉnh Aklan, nhân kỷ niệm ngày mất của the XIx Martyrs of Aklan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 23 มีนาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในจังหวัด Aklan เนื่องในโอกาสครบรอบการถึงแก่อสัญกรรมของ the XIx Martyrs of Aklan
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 23 Maret setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Provinsi Aklan, dalam rangka memperingati hari wafat the XIx Martyrs of Aklan
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 23 Mac setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Wilayah Aklan, sempena memperingati hari kematian the XIx Martyrs of Aklan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7806_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In order to commemorate the death anniversary of the 19 martyrs of Aklan, the pioneers of the propaganda campaign of the Katipunan and who were instrumental in the suppression of the atrocities committed towards the patriots of Aklan, the 23rd day of March of every year is hereby declared as a special public holiday in the Province of Aklan.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
